item.subject: science
item.stem:
Qadir looks at a clear drop of pond water. With his unaided eyes he sees nothing moving in it. His teacher says the tiniest living organisms may still be present. He considers a microscope, an ordinary magnifying glass, his unaided eyes again, or a flat windowpane.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: He should use a microscope, because those organisms are too small for the unaided eye.
options.B: An ordinary magnifying glass is enough to see the tiniest organisms clearly.
options.C: His unaided eyes are enough, because clear pond water has nothing tiny to observe.
options.D: A flat windowpane will magnify them, because any clear glass makes small things look larger.
